$comment: Figma style name → GridKit token. Source: libs/ui/src/tokens/shadow.ts + Figma file bCDJhVLlAFSIZtPFbEwDRO node 36:2. Usage: tokenPath → useTheme() dot-path, cssVar → --gds-* reference only (never emit in TSX). Note: Figma shadows are published styles (not variable-bound). Dark-mode variants have no GridKit token equivalent — dark theme handles them via the theme override system.

$usage.keyQuestion: What GridKit shadow token corresponds to this Figma shadow style or UI element elevation?
lookupSteps: 1. Figma style name (e.g. 'Shadow/Light Mode/shadow 1'): find in light group by key → tokenPath.
2. Shadow CSS value: query valueIndex[value] → tokenPath string.
3. By UI element role: consult elevationDecisionGuide — e.g. 'dropdown/popover'→shadows.box.2, 'modal'→shadows.modal.default, 'snackbar'→shadows.snackbar.default.
criticalRules: Design drift: Figma shadow values for levels 1-3 differ from GridKit token values. See designDrift. Token value is ALWAYS canonical — never use Figma raw values in code.
Dark mode: no separate GridKit shadow tokens; dark ThemeProvider override resolves automatically.
themeAccess for numeric box levels uses bracket notation: theme.shadows?.box?.['1'].
Semantic aliases (modal, snackbar, inlineNotification) should be preferred over box.* for those components.

light.$comment: Light mode shadows. Figma naming: 'Shadow/Light Mode/shadow <N>'. Maps to shadows.box.<N> in GridKit. Values for levels 1-3 have minor design drift from the Figma baseline — see designDrift section.

Shadow/Light Mode/shadow 1.drift: Figma is single-layer; token is multi-layer Material-style. Use token value.

Shadow/Light Mode/shadow 2.drift: Blur differs: Figma 14px vs token 5px. Use token value.

dark.$comment: Dark mode shadows use off-white rgba(250,249,249,...) instead of black. No corresponding GridKit token exists — dark theme handles elevation via the theme override system. Provided here for reference only; never hardcode dark shadow values in TSX.

Shadow/Dark Mode/shadow 1.note: No GridKit token. Resolved by dark theme override of shadows.box.1.

Shadow/Dark Mode/shadow 2.note: No GridKit token. Resolved by dark theme override of shadows.box.2.

Shadow/Dark Mode/shadow 3.note: No GridKit token. Resolved by dark theme override of shadows.box.3.

Shadow/Dark Mode/shadow 4.note: No GridKit token. Resolved by dark theme override of shadows.box.4.

Shadow/Dark Mode/shadow 5.note: No GridKit token. Resolved by dark theme override of shadows.box.5.

semantic.$comment: Component-level semantic shadow tokens. All resolve to DEFAULT_SHADOW = '0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.10)'. This value sits between Figma shadow 2 and 3 and is not explicitly represented in the Figma shadow scale — it is a GridKit-only semantic alias.

valueIndex.$comment: Reverse-lookup: CSS box-shadow string → tokenPath. Match the token value (not the Figma value) for levels 1-3. For DEFAULT_SHADOW use any of the semantic aliases — prefer the component-appropriate one.

elevationDecisionGuide.$comment: Which shadow level to use by component context.
elevationDecisionGuide.dark mode — any level: Use same tokenPath; dark theme override resolves to off-white shadow automatically

designDrift.$comment: Values where Figma baseline and GridKit token differ. Token value is canonical for implementation — never use Figma raw values in code.
